title: Moving from Dauphin Street to the new house, March 1952
summary: She dates the move to Sunday, March 2, 1952, from Dauphin Street, and explains the family bought a lot because her mother wanted a house of her own.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Oh, yes. It was March the 2nd, 1952. On a Sunday. Very good. And I remember them a lot because, um, I had to go to church that morning and, um, Mass was from the 830. And after Mass, um, I had to go back to the house to pick up something. And when I came over by myself, that's how I remember it was a Sunday, but it was March the 2nd.
Where had you been living before, just before you came here? Where did you live from?
On Dauphin Street. I think it was 18, 19, Dauphin.

Yeah. And we stayed there for five years. Why did George want to move over here? Do you know? Well, all of my mother's relatives were over here. And I think it was about two years before we moved that they purchased a lot. He wasn't too particular, but my mother always wanted a house of her own. And one morning, he was going to see his mother. And the three of us walked through the alley to the front. And there was a big for sale sign on the house. And it upset my mother very much because she had her trouble. So it was then that they decided to build.
